To my Avi Mama,

Happy 21st birthday, my love. ❤️ I hope 21 brings you happiness, peace, good health, and all the little things you've been wishing for. I hope you keep chasing the things that matter to you and never forget how special you are to me. I love you, Avi Mama. ❤️ Thank you for being you — for that smile I love so much, the way you look at me, and the comfort I find in your shoulders. Those little things might seem ordinary to you, but they mean the world to me. You're my favourite person to bother, my favourite face to look at, and one of my favourite reasons to smile. I wish I could wrap all my love into one gift, but for now you'll have to accept this tiny website made just for you. And… let's just say one tiny birthday surprise is still waiting for its main-character entrance. Hehe. 🖤 You can be an absolute idiot sometimes, and you definitely know how to annoy me, but somehow I still adore you more than I can explain. Your smile, your stare, and the comfort I find in your arms are little things I could never stop loving. I love you, Avi Mama. ❤️\n\nAnd even if the future has different plans for us, I will always be grateful that I got to love you, make memories with you, and call you mine in this chapter of our lives. Whatever happens, what we have means something to me. I hope 21 is kind to you, and I hope life gives you every beautiful thing you deserve.\n\nI love you — on the easy days, the messy days, and the days when we're both being ridiculous. Happy birthday, my favourite human. Always yours, your girl 💗
